items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: He was with us when we were with Al Hibbler

ctx.x: You're talking about your bass-playing brother as well.

Yeah. Bass player, too. Yeah, him too. He was with us when we were with Al Hibbler, and they throw out all that music at him, and they found out he couldn't read. So I told them, 'Well, I'll take care of him. I'll take him to the hotel and teach him, show him. Just follow me.'

Let me make this suggestion. Do you think that if you hadn't carried them, if you'd said, 'Look, I'd like to have you in my band, but you have to be able to make it, and I'll have to let you go until you get straight with the reading' and that sort of thing... Do you think that that, in the end, would have helped
